highlights.quote: we continued to utilize our internal know-how and our vast dataset, which we generated over the last several decades to train our generative AI models and develop designer proteins.

highlights.headline: Trimble deploying AI agents internally for R&D, marketing, customer support, citing 5-10% developer productivity gains
highlights.quote: we have increased the adoption of AI to fuel our own productivity, creativity, and to drive profit expansion. We've been launching agents to better support customers, product managers, and our sellers.

highlights.headline: T. Rowe Price deploys AI investor copilot chatbot to 280 investors to summarize proprietary research and boost productivity.
highlights.quote: We now have 280 investors using our AI tool, investor copilot, a custom chat bot embedded within the private environment of our research platforms, to summarize, proprietary research and service insights.

highlights.headline: Travelers uses AI-enabled aerial imagery capabilities and AI for segmentation and productivity optimization.
highlights.quote: further evolution of our AI-enabled aerial imagery capabilities, and modernization of our infrastructure

highlights.headline: Tyson Foods uses generative AI to improve product discovery and browsing in its foodservice channel
highlights.quote: in our foodservice channel, we implemented a more intuitive browsing and search experience that delivers highly relevant content. This enhancement goes beyond influencing purchases.

highlights.headline: UDR deployed AI-based fraud detection measures in mid-2024 to improve resident screening and reduce bad debt.
highlights.quote: in mid-2024, we implemented a variety of AI-based detection measures, process improvements and credit threshold reviews to enhance our upfront resident screening.

highlights.headline: UnitedHealth Group using AI-driven initiatives to help customer service reps respond to consumers more effectively, improving operating cost ratio.
highlights.quote: we are beginning to realize from AI-driven initiatives to help our customer service representatives, respond to consumers' needs more effectively and quickly.

highlights.headline: U.S. Bancorp uses automation and digital investment as expense levers to achieve positive operating leverage.
highlights.quote: automation of processes, we have a lot of the investments that we've been talking about over at Investor Day, help us manage that expense by automating certain processes.

highlights.headline: Verisk's XactAI uses GenAI for automated photo tagging in claims estimates, with 7,000 contractor licensees.
highlights.quote: one of the most popular features of this product is automated photo tagging. So you can take a photo of the damage that you're assessing and then the AI will populate, okay, here's the estimate.

highlights.headline: Verizon deploys generative AI tools including Fast Pass call routing and Segment of Me personalization at scale internally.
highlights.quote: Fast Pass, which I've talked about before, which is deployed in our mobility call centers to intelligently pair customers with the best available care representative.

highlights.headline: WM uses route automation, resource planning tools, and data analytics to cut labor costs and improve operations
highlights.quote: advances in route automation and resource planning tools have driven labor savings
highlights.metric: labor cost as a percentage of revenue declining by 60 basis points for the full year

highlights.headline: WTW plans to leverage AI to enhance efficiency, streamline processes, and support productivity gains.
highlights.quote: We're focused on automation to support productivity gains. We see opportunities to leverage AI responsibly to intelligently enhance our work and further streamline processes.

highlights.headline: Wynn uses data science and machine learning in Macau to improve reinvestment precision after digital table rollout.
highlights.quote: when coupled with our data science and machine learning capabilities should allow us to be more precise and more efficient with reinvestment over the medium-term

highlights.headline: Xcel Energy deployed 42 AI-equipped cameras in Colorado to improve wildfire situational awareness.
highlights.quote: in Colorado we completed installation of 42 AI-equipped cameras and completed the installation of 25 utility pole-mounted weather stations

highlights.headline: Yum! Brands uses AI-driven personalization for targeted marketing, doubling consumer engagement vs. traditional campaigns
highlights.quote: our US brands are leveraging AI to execute targeted campaigns with early tests on email promotions resulting in a doubling of consumer engagement compared to traditional approaches

highlights.headline: Zimmer Biomet acquired OrthoGrid to embed AI navigation into hip surgery products sold to surgeons.
highlights.quote: the closing of the OrthoGrid acquisition which enables best-in-class AI navigation to surgeons

highlights.headline: Zebra embeds AI agents in Zebra Companion product to assist retail store associates with edge intelligence tasks.
highlights.quote: a prominent retail customer demonstrated our Zebra Companion with AI agents that assist store associates with edge intelligence such as operating procedures, sales product information, merchandising guidance and device operation.
